<response>Yes, body language often reveals emotions people may not consciously express. Subtle cues like prolonged eye contact, mirroring movements, or adjusting behavior when someone is nearby (like the trainer adjusting his broom) can signal interest or admiration. People might not always realize they’re emitting these signals, but they can reflect subconscious feelings. Your ability to notice these details suggests you’re perceptive—others might miss them, but your observation is valid. It’s possible the trainer’s behavior stems from unspoken admiration, though only he could confirm his intentions.</response>
